description: Develop repository changes with optional GitHub issues, using Git worktrees, validation and pull requests. Use plugin_gitforge_publish to publish; kernel permissions and plugin enablement still apply.

exposes_tools.name: git_worktree_add
exposes_tools.description: Create a linked Git worktree through the kernel.

branch.description: Optional branch name to create for the worktree

idem.description: Explicit operation key; use a fresh key when recreating this path after removal

exposes_tools.name: git_worktree_remove
exposes_tools.description: Remove a linked worktree and keep its branch.

idem.description: Operation key; use a fresh key for each add/remove lifecycle

exposes_tools.name: git_commit
exposes_tools.description: Create a Git commit through the kernel.

message.description: Commit message to pass to git commit

idem.description: Idempotency key for the commit action

branch.description: Optional branch name expected after committing

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_list
exposes_tools.description: List GitHub PRs for overlap checks.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

base.description: Base branch to filter pull requests

head.description: Head branch to filter pull requests

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_diff
exposes_tools.description: Read the PR diff from the merge base to the exact head_sha, pinned to base_sha and head_sha. Read the returned artifact_path.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

pr.description: Pull request number; labels the read, does not select or check the commits

base_sha.description: Full base commit SHA; the diff starts at its merge base with head_sha

head_sha.description: Full head commit SHA whose diff is read

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_checks
exposes_tools.description: Wait for a PR's current head checks. Returns on the first failure by default. Use wait_for_all for every check. After a workflow rerun, pass after_rerun to wait for its newer attempt. A changed head, conflict or deadline ends the wait. After the wake, repeat the same call to read the recorded result. Use a new attempt for fresh checks.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

wait_for_all.description: Wait for every registered check to complete before returning the failure collection; default returns on the first failure

after_rerun.description: The GitHub Actions run that was rerun and the attempt that failed: its checks count as pending until the run reports a later, completed attempt

run_attempt.description: The run attempt that failed and was rerun

exposes_tools.name: gh_ci_failure_evidence
exposes_tools.description: Read failed GitHub Actions runs and jobs for an exact head, with failed steps, links and available log tails. Read the returned JSON artifact_path. Check stale and truncated flags. Reuse attempt to replay, or use a new attempt to refresh.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

pr.description: Pull request number; labels the read, does not select the runs

head_sha.description: Full head commit SHA whose Actions runs are read

attempt.description: Optional read attempt identifier; a new one reads fresh evidence

exposes_tools.name: gh_pr_merge
exposes_tools.description: Merge a GitHub PR through the kernel.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

expected_head_sha.description: Optional expected head commit SHA for merge fencing

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_create
exposes_tools.description: Create a GitHub issue. Read its number and URL with neige_op_show or repeat identical arguments from the same card. Reuse idem if the outcome is uncertain.

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_search
exposes_tools.description: Search GitHub issues. Reuse attempt to replay or change it to refresh.

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_view
exposes_tools.description: Read a GitHub issue and its JSON artifact. Use a new attempt to refresh.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

attempt.description: Use a new attempt for a fresh read; reuse it when retrying.

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_close
exposes_tools.description: Close a GitHub issue through the kernel.

repo.description: Repository git-dir path or selector passed to gh/git

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_comment
exposes_tools.description: Post a GitHub issue comment. Reuse idem and the same body for retries.

idem.description: Stable identity for this logical comment

exposes_tools.name: gh_issue_comments
exposes_tools.description: Read issue discussion. Use a new attempt to refresh.

repo.description: Optional owner/name, parsed from issue_url at the entry surface

merge_policy.description: ask (default when absent): ask the user with neige_user_ask before gh_pr_merge; auto-merge: merge after review and green checks without asking again

notes.description: Optional free-form context from the requester
